title: Oven Roasted Turkish Lamb Pilaf
description: A flavorful Turkish dish featuring ground lamb and aromatic spices, served over a bed of fluffy pilaf.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground lamb, ground allspice, salt, and black pepper, and mix well with your hands until just combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, then add the lamb mixture and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Stir in the chicken broth and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
Add the basmati rice to the skillet, stir to combine, and transfer the skillet to the preheated oven.
Bake, covered with foil, for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
